meta.name: Breathing Grid
meta.description: A zen grid. A soft full-canvas field of muted color cells breathes with a slow, spatially-varying wave — sin(x*k + y*k2 + t*slow) — whose depth is scaled by SMOOTHED energy, so the whole surface inhales and exhales gently. Over it, a lattice of small dots at the grid intersections pulses softly with the mid band. Alpha blend, no additive, no harsh flashes: the calmest visual of the set. In silence the grid settles to a still, dim wash that barely drifts.
meta.author: ViewMusic built-in

color.v: (settings.tint_r + settings.tint_g + settings.tint_b) * 0.22 + (0.08 + 0.45 * energy_s) * (0.5 + 0.5 * sin(x * settings.density + y * settings.density * 0.7 + phase)) * (0.6 + 0.4 * sin(x * settings.density * 0.6 - y * settings.density + phase * 1.3))

element.w: (settings.dotSize * (0.7 + 0.6 * (0.5 + 0.5 * sin((i % floor(settings.density)) * 1.7 + floor(i / floor(settings.density)) * 2.3 + phase))) * (0.6 + 0.8 * mid_s)) / aspect
element.h: settings.dotSize * (0.7 + 0.6 * (0.5 + 0.5 * sin((i % floor(settings.density)) * 1.7 + floor(i / floor(settings.density)) * 2.3 + phase))) * (0.6 + 0.8 * mid_s)
